These companies may use aggregated information (not including your name, address, email address or telephone number) about your visits to this and other Websites in order to provide advertisements about goods and services of interest to you.
findings.rationale: The policy explicitly mentions the collection of aggregated information from visits to websites.
findings.verifier_reason: The policy evidence mentions the use of third-party advertising companies to serve ads, which involves the collection of aggregated information.
